newsitem.title: USA: MotivePower gets new credit line.
newsitem.headline: MotivePower gets new credit line.

text.p: MotivePower Industries Inc, formerly called MK Rail Corp, said on Thursday it received a commitment for a new four-year, $75 million domestic credit facility from Bank of America to replace an existing facility.
MotivePower also said it received an immediate interest-rate reduction under its existing credit facility with a Bank of America affiliate.

The company said it would record a one-time, after-tax expense for the refinancing of about $0.05 per share in the fourth quarter, but it still expected the fourth quarter to be its strongest of the year.
MotivePower also said future savings on interest and administrative expenses under the new facility would significantly exceed the one-time expense.
The company said during the first nine months of 1996, it reduced debt from about $120 million to about $55 million, which would contribute to lower interest expense in 1997.
